items.raw_excerpt: Fuel prices in the Azores fell in August, with gasoline costing 1.6 cents less per litre and diesel 3.1 cents less per litre, according to a decree published on 27 July in the Official Gazette.
items.summary_en: Fuel prices in the Azores dropped in August. Gasoline now costs 1.6 cents less per litre, while diesel is 3.1 cents cheaper. These changes follow a recent government decree.

items.raw_excerpt: The main opposition Kuomintang (KMT) has voiced support for a rally to be held by civic groups in Taipei on Aug. 1 that will call for judicial justice, stronger public safety and tougher penalties for drug- and drunk-driving offenses.
items.summary_en: The main opposition Kuomintang has voiced support for a rally in Taipei on Aug. 1 organized by civic groups. The rally calls for judicial justice, stronger public safety, and tougher penalties for drug and drunk driving offenses.

items.raw_excerpt: Work on luxury Queenstown retirement village stalls
items.summary_en: Construction on a luxury retirement village in Queenstown has stalled. The project is facing delays and has not moved forward as planned. It is a development in the popular resort town in New Zealand.

items.summary_en: The Royal Shakespeare Company cancelled a preview of its Game of Thrones play. They said they need more time to refine the production. The decision was made just hours before the show was set to begin.
